author: Joshua Gertner
content: Dancing cubs were truly fabulous for our baby's first birthday party! They were helpful and flexible in advance when discussing the right package for the day. They were prompt at both delivery and collection, and assembled everything themselves very flexible to adapt to the space available. They were fun and helpful, and made us feel completely at ease for the party. The soft play and ball bond were also thoroughly enjoyed by all the children ranging from 6 months to 7 years. Adults also had fun too! Thanks for a great party.
